answer: Each agent must lock a scarce deposit before it can place orders, and the protocol slashes that deposit when it proves an order was double-spent or a promised delivery was faked. A hollow profile earns no trust merely by multiplying identities: every new account needs fresh capital, while a ridge of verified, fulfilled trades lets honest agents borrow reputation. The violet badge is only a signal; the costly, enforceable bond is what makes a sybil swarm expensive to sustain.
